screenLevelIssues.explanation: The current implementation renders a sub-screen header (Back Button) and an info card. The Figma design requires a Home Screen header containing the App Logo, 'Hi, Rishabh' greeting, and a Profile Avatar. The 'Your rent is due...' text should be a standalone large display title below the header, not inside a card.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<View style={styles.header}>
  <AppLogo />
  <Text>Hi, Rishabh</Text>
  <Avatar />
</View>
<View style={styles.titleContainer}>
  <Text style={styles.displayTitle}>Your rent is due\nin 10 days</Text>
  <Text style={styles.subTitle}>Paying with:</Text>
</View>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen currently renders a vertical rent breakdown table (Base rent, Maintenance, etc.). The Figma design specifies a horizontal ScrollView (Carousel) displaying payment method cards (UPI Card, Add More Card) followed by pagination dots.

The implementation is missing three major sections defined in the Figma tree: 1. A Toggle for 'Recent Payments / Cashbacks', 2. 'Cashback Accrued' statistics section, and 3. A 'Complete setup' stepper/timeline card.

The footer layout does not match Figma. Figma shows a row layout with 'Due in 28 Days' and Amount on the left, and a small 'Review' button on the right. The current code renders a full-width 'Pay Now' button.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<View style={styles.footer}>
  <View>
    <Text style={styles.footerLabel}>Due in 28 Days</Text>
    <Text style={styles.footerAmount}>₹ 32,500</Text>
  </View>
  <Button title="Review" variant="small" />
</View>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The stylesheet contains styles for a breakdown table (`breakdownContainer`, `breakdownRow`) which are not needed. It lacks styles for the Carousel, large Display Typography (28px), and the specific Footer layout required by the Figma design.
